dataset.id_mapping: HDF5 zero-based row ID + 1 = SQL bigint ID

provenance_scope.git_sources: host checkouts at experiment invocation; they do not attest which source bytes built the selected Docker image

opentenbase_source.scope: host checkout at experiment invocation; not a container-image build-source attestation

pgvector_source.scope: host checkout at experiment invocation; not a container-image build-source attestation

local_connection.auth: ephemeral SCRAM password; never persisted; isolated volume removed

load.method: chunked binary COPY; ascending source row order

metadata.query_plan:
SET
Limit
  InitPlan 1
    ->  Index Scan using items_pkey on items items_1
          Index Cond: (id = 1)
  ->  Index Scan using items_embedding_hnsw_idx on items
        Order By: (embedding <=> (InitPlan 1).col1)

building index: writing index pages to WAL

selection.rule: smallest tuning ef meeting target; otherwise no selection and report ceiling 400

tuning.timing_protocol: randomized (repetition, ef, query); each timed EXPLAIN follows identical untimed result retrieval; warm-cache server execution, not end-to-end latency/QPS
tuning.recall_protocol: strict ID-overlap Recall@K; repeated timings do not increase unique query count
